status: CALCULATION_ONLY; candidate settings, not firmware configuration or measured performance

sources.revision: DS10693 Rev 11, Table 74 p140, Equation 1 p141; same selected RADC/CADC values and equation also read in locally stored Rev10

assumptions: Ideal voltage source with negligible output impedance; constant input during acquisition.
Internal 6kohm/7pF are conservative datasheet model bounds, not measured values at 3.3V.
R 1% is a calculation assumption, not an inspection of owned parts.
No pin/protection leakage, charge injection, layout parasitics, ADC intrinsic error, source noise or reference error included in dynamic models.
A full 3.3V initial difference is an analysis envelope, not the known initial voltage of the physical capacitor after every conversion.
Models below are separate and must not be treated as one proof of complete circuit accuracy.

no_external_cap_model.definition: C1 omitted ONLY for explanatory source-resistance acquisition model. Existing CAD retains C1.
no_external_cap_model.formula: tau=(Rexternal+RADC)*CADC; residual=deltaV*exp(-t/tau); ST Eq1 uses t=(k-0.5)/fADC.

with_external_cap_single_share_model.definition: External C already settled; one passive charge redistribution; sensor replenishment ignored during sharing. Does not bound every internal switching charge mechanism.
with_external_cap_single_share_model.C90nF_note: Initial -10% tolerance example only; not an effective-capacitance lower bound over bias and temperature.

candidate_schedule.per_channel_sample_rate: NOT_SELECTED; distinguish acquisition window, repeated acquisitions, and 10Hz result generation.

decision: 14MHz/480cycles retained as a conservative candidate for subsequent review. 12kohm/100nF not approved: repeat-sample recovery, source stability, aliasing and post-calibration error budget remain. Longer acquisition does not remove steady-state leakage error.
